validations.name: Location exists in branch
validations.message: Location code not found for the selected branch

column.name: location_name
column.heading: Location Name
column.descr: Location name (display only)

column.name: verifier_employee_code
column.heading: Verifier
column.descr: Employee responsible for conducting this verification cycle

column.name: verifier_employee_name
column.heading: Verifier Name
column.descr: Verifier name (display only)

column.name: status

sql_model.form_descr: Asset-level findings for this verification cycle

column.name: verification_cycle_no
column.heading: Cycle No
column.descr: Parent verification cycle

column.name: line_no
column.heading: Line No
column.descr: Line sequence number within the cycle

column.name: asset_code
column.heading: Asset Code
column.descr: Asset being verified

validations.name: Asset valid for verification
validations.message: Asset must exist and be Capitalized (unless this line is marked Extra-Unregistered)

business_logic.description: Validate the asset code against the register unless the line is Extra-Unregistered
business_logic.spec: If PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND is not 'EXTRA_UNREGISTERED', verify ASSET_CODE exists in FAM_ASSET_REGISTER and is Capitalized, returning an error if not (dependency: FAM_ASSET_REGISTER does not yet carry a STATUS column, so until it is added only existence can be checked here — revisit once STATUS exists). If PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND = 'EXTRA_UNREGISTERED', skip the existence/status check entirely since this line records an asset physically found that is not (yet) in the register.

validations.name: Asset unique in cycle
validations.message: This asset has already been added to this verification cycle

business_logic.description: Default the expected location/custodian for the scanned asset
business_logic.spec: On change of ASSET_CODE, default EXPECTED_LOCATION_CODE and EXPECTED_EMPLOYEE_CODE from the asset's current BRANCH_CODE/LOCATION_CODE/ASSIGNED_EMPLOYEE_CODE once those columns exist on FAM_ASSET_REGISTER (dependency: they do not exist yet — only ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, CAPITALIZATION_DATE are currently present, so until this dependency is resolved, default EXPECTED_LOCATION_CODE to the header form's LOCATION_CODE as an interim fallback and leave EXPECTED_EMPLOYEE_CODE blank). Return {"updates": {"expected_location_code": ..., "expected_location_name": ..., "expected_employee_code": ..., "expected_employee_name": ...}}.

column.name: asset_name
column.heading: Asset Name
column.descr: Asset name from the register (display only)

column.name: physical_status_found
column.heading: Physical Status
column.descr: Outcome of the physical check for this asset

column.name: verified_date
column.heading: Verified Date
column.descr: Date this asset was physically verified (stamped by the Scan/Mark actions, or entered manually)

column.name: remarks
column.heading: Remarks
column.descr: Notes on this finding (e.g. damage description, reason not found)

column.name: expected_location_code
column.heading: Expected Location
column.descr: Location the asset was expected to be found at

validations.name: Expected location exists in branch
validations.message: Expected location not found for the cycle's branch

column.name: expected_location_name
column.heading: Expected Location Name
column.descr: Expected location name (display only)

column.name: expected_employee_code
column.heading: Expected Custodian
column.descr: Employee the asset was expected to be assigned to

column.name: expected_employee_name
column.heading: Expected Custodian Name
column.descr: Expected custodian name (display only)

business_logic.description: Confirm an asset by scanning its QR/barcode
business_logic.spec: Stamp VERIFIED_DATE with today's date and set PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND = 'FOUND' for this line (unless already marked Damaged or Extra-Unregistered, which are left as-is). Return {"updates": {"physical_status_found": ..., "verified_date": ...}}.

validations.name: Cycle open
validations.message: Assets can only be scanned while the cycle is Planned or In Progress.

business_logic.description: Mark this line as Not Found
business_logic.spec: Set PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND = 'NOT_FOUND' and stamp VERIFIED_DATE with today's date for this line. Return {"updates": {"physical_status_found": ..., "verified_date": ...}}.

validations.name: Cycle open
validations.message: Assets can only be marked while the cycle is Planned or In Progress.

business_logic.spec: Set PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND = 'DAMAGED' and stamp VERIFIED_DATE with today's date for this line. Return {"updates": {"physical_status_found": ..., "verified_date": ...}}.

validations.name: Cycle open
validations.message: Assets can only be marked while the cycle is Planned or In Progress.

validations.name: Editable only before approval
validations.message: Only cycles in Planned or In Progress status can be edited.

business_logic.description: Load capitalized assets for the selected branch/location into a pick grid
business_logic.spec: Query FAM_ASSET_REGISTER for assets that are Capitalized and currently located at the header's BRANCH_CODE/LOCATION_CODE (dependency: FAM_ASSET_REGISTER does not yet carry STATUS/BRANCH_CODE/LOCATION_CODE columns needed to filter this way -- revisit once those columns exist, e.g. via the Asset Register object; until then, offer all assets and let the user deselect), excluding ASSET_CODE values already present as lines on this VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO. Return each candidate as a row with ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, EXPECTED_LOCATION_CODE, EXPECTED_EMPLOYEE_CODE for the user to multi-select in the grid; selected rows are appended as new verification lines.

validations.name: Cycle open for loading
validations.message: Assets can only be loaded while the cycle is Planned or In Progress.

business_logic.description: Move the cycle to Pending Approval
business_logic.spec: Set STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' and return a confirmation message.

validations.name: Must be open
validations.message: Only a Planned or In Progress cycle can be submitted for approval.

validations.name: At least one line
validations.message: Add at least one asset line before submitting for approval.

validations.name: All lines verified
validations.message: Every line must be marked Found, Not Found, Damaged or Extra-Unregistered before submitting for approval.

business_logic.description: Ensure no verification line is left unmarked
business_logic.spec: Count lines on this VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO in FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION_LINE where PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND is null or blank; return an error string naming the count if any are found, otherwise return nothing.

business_logic.description: Approve the verification cycle and apply findings to the Asset Register
business_logic.spec: Set STATUS = 'CLOSED'. For every line on this VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO with PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND = 'NOT_FOUND', update FAM_ASSET_REGISTER.STATUS = 'UNDER_INVESTIGATION' for that ASSET_CODE (dependency: FAM_ASSET_REGISTER does not yet have a STATUS column -- this update must be revisited once that column exists). For every line with PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND = 'DAMAGED', raise a follow-up remark flag (e.g. append a standard 'Damage follow-up required' note to REMARKS or create a follow-up task) for maintenance/insurance review. Return a confirmation message. Approved cycle data feeds the Verification Report (R).

validations.name: Must be pending approval
validations.message: Only a Pending Approval cycle can be approved.

confirmation.message: Approve verification cycle {form.verification_cycle_no}? This will update the Asset Register for any Not Found assets and close the cycle.

business_logic.spec: Set STATUS = 'CANCELLED' and return a confirmation message.

validations.name: Not yet closed
validations.message: A Closed or already Cancelled cycle cannot be cancelled again.
